name: DFPlayer Mini MP3 Player
fullName: DFPlayer Mini Embedded MP3 Audio Player Module with MicroSD Slot
tagline: Standalone MP3/WAV audio decoder with onboard 3W amplifier and serial UART control
description: The DFPlayer Mini is a compact and low-cost MP3 audio playback module that connects directly to a speaker. It supports FAT16 and FAT32 microSD cards (up to 32GB) and decodes MP3 and WAV files with 24-bit DAC output. Controlled via simple UART serial commands (9600 baud).

specs.onboardAmp: 3W mono speaker output (can drive 4Ω/8Ω speaker directly)

pinout.name: UART RX
pinout.desc: Serial command input from microcontroller TX (add 1kΩ resistor for 5V boards)

pinout.name: UART TX
pinout.desc: Serial feedback output to microcontroller RX

pinout.name: Busy State
pinout.desc: LOW during playback, HIGH when idle

wiringNote: Always insert a 1kΩ series resistor between Arduino TX (5V) and DFPlayer RX pin (3.3V logic) to prevent serial data corruption and audible popping noise.
commonMistakes: Not naming files with 4 digits inside an 'mp3' folder (e.g., /mp3/0001.mp3)
Omitting the 1kΩ series resistor on RX line causing loud buzzing/reboots
Powering from USB while driving high speaker volumes without sufficient current
